verdicts.why: MCU Wiki lists Stokes Crime Family as 'formerly'. His time with Mama Mabel's crew is youthful backstory shown only in flashbacks (LC102, LC107), and he runs the barbershop throughout Luke Cage S1.

In Iron Fist S1 (episode 8 per the wiki, 'Ousted') Wilkins and the shareholders vote Ward and Joy out of Rand Enterprises. After Harold's death in the finale, Ward runs the company with Danny, so he is back in during S1.

In S1 the board ousts Joy (IF108), Maria Rodriguez gets her reinstated (IF110), and in IF113 she leaves New York for Paris to meet Davos. Ward says he won't run the company alone 'now that Joy had left', so she is out by the end of S1. In S2 she only finishes the divestment.

The wiki lists USMC as 'formerly'. Frank left the service after Kandahar in 2015 and came home before the Central Park massacre, so he is out of both the Marines and Cerberus before Daredevil S2. In The Punisher S1, Cerberus appears only in flashbacks.
The wiki lists USMC and Cerberus Squad as 'formerly'. In The Punisher S1, Gunner is already a former Marine hiding alone after leaking the footage, and his service appears only in flashback.

The wiki lists USN as 'formerly'. Curtis lost his leg and left the Navy before The Punisher S1 and is a civilian in both seasons. The veterans' support group is not a tracked group, so Independent is right.
The wiki lists NSA as 'formerly'. Carson Wolf shot him and he was presumed dead before S1, which shows this only in flashback. Throughout S1 he is in hiding, not with the NSA.

In Echo episode 3 (EC103), Tuklo saves the ambushed Lighthorsemen, and 'Once the battle was over with, Tuklo became a permanent member of the Lighthorsemen'. The wiki lists her affiliations as Choctaw and Lighthorsemen. The source names the group plainly, and the dataset tracks similar tribal bodies.

Fisk's administration ends in Daredevil: Born Again S2: Rivera brings him the exile deal, and in the finale Fisk leaves New York. The wiki says she became interim mayor after Fisk's defeat, and Brand New Day only shows her already in office, so the break belongs in S2. Confidence is medium: S2 never shows her sworn in.

At the end of Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 Nebula declines to lead the team ('I'm gonna lead the city'), Rocket becomes leader, and she stays to run Knowhere. The wiki lists the Guardians as 'formerly' under 'Leaving the Guardians'.

value: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
verdicts.why: DGSE is backstory (Rumlow reads it from his file, and the wiki says 'formerly'), so it goes. Without it, the Independent stage at The Winter Soldier is a departure from nothing. Villain records never open with Independent; they leave the time before the first group blank. That leaves only the LAF stage, and 'left' should drop The Winter Soldier.
The wiki calls him a 'former Lieutenant Colonel' recruited as a veteran into Extremis before the film. In Iron Man 3 he serves only as Killian's A.I.M. lieutenant.
Brandt lost her arm in earlier military service. Killian then recruited her into Extremis and A.I.M., and Iron Man 3 shows her only as an A.I.M. agent. Her Army service is backstory.

After the Battle of Ta Lo, 'Slattery later decided to stay in Ta Lo to be with Morris' (the wiki lists Ta Lo Armed Forces as 'formerly'). Ta Lo is a tracked group whose residents, Morris among them, are filed in it. In Wonder Man episode 2 he leaves Ta Lo for LA and goes to work for Damage Control.

The wiki lists the Sokovian Armed Forces and EKO Scorpion as 'formerly'. F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s 'Zemo ran EKO Scorpion' is past tense, and in Civil War he acts alone after Sokovia. Villain records with no group are empty. The A:helmut-zemo twin has a pending owner call on the same point, so the two should be kept consistent.
His Naval Academy, SEAL and JSOC service is backstory (Everett Ross recounts it). By the museum robbery he is working with Klaue, and the wiki lists USN as 'formerly'.
Kaecilius formed the Zealots and rebelled against the Ancient One before the film, and Doctor Strange opens with the Zealots stealing the Cagliostro page. The wiki lists MMA as 'formerly'.
The wiki says that when S.H.I.E.L.D. collapsed in 2014, Bill Foster took Ava back in. Ant-Man and the Wasp (2018) recounts that only as backstory. 'left' should drop Ant-Man and the Wasp too.
His S.H.I.E.L.D. and G.O.L.I.A.T.H. work is decades-old backstory. In Ant-Man and the Wasp he is a UC Berkeley professor, and the wiki lists S.H.I.E.L.D. as 'formerly'.

In Loki S1 episode 5 he leads his army of variants (the wiki names them the Loki Bandits, 'formerly'). After he double-crosses Boastful Loki, 'his own followers' turn on him in the brawl, so he is ousted within the same episode. Confidence is medium: 'Loki Bandits' is a new group name, though the source names it plainly.

Tony fired Beck from Stark Industries in 2016, at the MIT B.A.R.F. lecture before Far From Home. In the film that is only recounted, and he leads a crew of fired ex-Stark staff. The wiki lists Stark Industries as 'formerly'.

The Ennead Council betrayed Ammit and bound her in the ushabti about 2,000 years before Moon Knight, and the wiki lists the Ennead Council as 'formerly'. She is never with the Ennead during the show, so both stages go and 'left' should drop Moon Knight.

The episode summary says Nkati 'fled Wakanda with stolen vibranium' and had become a pirate before Noni's mission. In the episode he only tells her of his War Dogs past, and the wiki lists War Dogs and the Royal Guard as 'formerly'. Both stages go, and 'left' should drop Eyes of Wakanda.

In the post-credits scene Yelena does work for Valentina, but nothing there ties that job to O.X.E. Valentina is CIA in Wakanda Forever, and O.X.E. is first named in Thunderbolts*. The dataset files O.X.E. at Thunderbolts* for everyone Valentina hired earlier (John Walker hired in FATWS, the A:yelena twin, Valentina herself), so the unsure case keeps what's there.
